title: Why Enterprises Fail to Gain Real Value from GenAI and Agentic AI
description: Many enterprises neuter GenAI’s potential by reducing it to report automation. Learn how a $50B e-commerce company’s caution turned AI innovation into a Python script — and how to avoid the same trap.
